coverage_scope: Preprocessed concept/text corpus indexed by tools/konzepte-erfassen.py. This freezes a high-value semantic submanifest only. It does not by itself enumerate every code file, database, model, binary or other asset under the Drive clay root.
exact_level0_rule: Do not use documents=655 as the complete Drive Level-0 denominator until non-concept semantic/code/assets obligations are reconciled or explicitly classified NO_RESEARCH_DELTA/non-semantic.
source_integrity_notes: Drive clay root now exposes extracted folders in addition to the 663552000-byte tar.xz, so the prior connector-size blocker no longer blocks semantic traversal of the extracted tree.
KORRELATIONEN.md records explicit version chains and supersession candidates; ingestion must preserve chronology rather than treating same-name files as independent equal-current truth.
HYPOTHESEN.md explicitly labels free-model assessments as proposals rather than findings; they remain hypothesis material, not evidence.
